correctness.rationale: Re-audited the complete corrected RESULT.md, which retains the resonant theorem and uses the collision-free case only as a credited comparator. Orthogonality of the Fourier square leaves precisely the midpoint collision 0+2m=m+m, with cross term 4 Re(u_0 u_2 conj(u_1)^2). Positive real amplitudes attain its upper bound. The gap at a=1/2 expands into the displayed nonnegative squares and vanishes only for a constant, which extends to smaller a by coefficient monotonicity. For a>1/2 the 0,m pair has a mixed optimum greater than 1 and dominates either other pair; adding a positive upper-mode amplitude improves it at first order, even at a=1 where the pair payoffs can tie. Every global optimizer is thus interior and has the aligned phase. In coordinates (t,z)=(|c_m|²,|c_{2m}|), the Taylor terms are 4δt−3t²/4+tz−z² and the Hessian has determinant 2 with negative first diagonal. Compactness at the unique critical constant puts all optimizers in the analytic chart. The unique local stationary branch has (t,z)=(4δ,2δ)+O(δ²), giving the norm coefficient 8 and upper-mode energy 4δ²+O(δ³). The credited collision-free first branch yields coefficient 16/3 by maximizing the two-mode quadratic, proving the 3/2 ratio. The original nonresonant formulas are consistent with the broader theorem; removal addresses coverage rather than a mathematical error.
residual_risks: Unique resonant magnitudes are proved only near onset (and trivially in the constant regime); no all-radius resonant norm or general non-B₂ theorem is claimed.

evidence: The B₂ staircase covers complex analytic sets having unique unordered pair sums and explicitly excludes midpoint phase terms. Its threshold equations evaluated at {0,m,n} give precisely a=1/2 and b/a+b=3/2 when n≠2m. Classical hypercontractivity gives context for contractivity, while the accessible general sources concern linear-polynomial or global spherical problems.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The covered nonresonant branch is not part of the repaired contribution. A contraction bound at or below the first threshold says nothing about strictly supercritical support or onset coefficients. The surviving spectrum is not B₂.

value.rationale: The repaired claim isolates a natural obstruction to the collision-free activation staircase: one midpoint convolution term forces a higher harmonic into every optimizer immediately above the sharp contraction threshold. The precise quadratic energy onset of this harmonic and its 3/2 enhancement of the leading excess quantify an effect not supplied by unweighted endpoint constants or qualitative mode persistence. This is value of the resonance theorem, not of republishing the covered nonresonant specialization.
residual_risks: Local onset law, not a classification of all resonant spectra or a closed all-radius resonant norm.
